info.title: Deliverect Store  API
info.description: The Endpoints allows multiple functions to query and update the availability of customer's stores and the products in their account

oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Obtain an access token using the partner client ID and client secret. Send the returned token with each API request in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

examples: GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH

triggerUpdate.description: Set to true to republish existing menus and communicate the updated opening hours to ordering platforms. Set to false to update opening hours without publishing menus.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday.

startTime.description: Opening time in the location's local time, using 24-hour HH:MM format.

endTime.description: Closing time in the location's local time, using 24-hour HH:MM format.

openingHours.description: Opening hours that apply to the location. Each entry contains dayOfWeek, startTime, and endTime. To represent hours that extend past midnight, split the range into two entries: one from 00:00 to the closing time, and one from the opening time to 23:59 (see the "Opening time past midnight" example).

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday.

startTime.description: Opening time in the location's local time, using 24-hour HH:MM format.

endTime.description: Closing time in the location's local time, using 24-hour HH:MM format.

openingHours.description: Opening hours that apply to the channel. Each entry contains dayOfWeek, startTime, and endTime. To represent hours that extend past midnight, split the range into two entries: one from 00:00 to the closing time, and one from the opening time to 23:59 (see the "Opening time past midnight" example).

channels.description: Channels within the location that have their own opening hours, overriding the location-level hours for that channel.

locations.description: Locations whose opening hours you want to update.

schema.description: Set opening hours for a given location and/or apply unique opening hours per channel(s) within a location. Multiple non-overlapping time ranges can be applied to a single weekday, at both location and channel level. Any weekday not included in the payload is assumed to be a day the store does not open.

Update Example.summary: Update opening hours for a location and channel

Opening time past midnight.summary: Location open 10am to 2am the next day, every day

schema.description: Define specific days and hours when a store should remain closed due to holidays. Useful for managing store hours during festive seasons or special occasions.

locations.description: Locations whose holiday hours you want to update. Each object contains the location's id and the holiday periods during which it should remain closed.

id.description: The location ID of the store.

holidays.description: Holiday periods during which the store should remain closed. Send an empty array to delete all existing holiday hours for the location.

startTime.description: The start of the holiday period, in ISO 8601 date-time format in the store's local time.

endTime.description: The end of the holiday period, in ISO 8601 date-time format in the store's local time.

Delete Holiday Hours.summary: Delete all holiday hours for a location

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the location to sync products for.

parameters.name: forceUpdate
parameters.description: When set to `true`, forces a full product sync even if products have not changed since the last sync.

400.description: Bad Request — the sync request could not be processed. This may occur if the location ID is invalid or the location does not have a POS system configured.

startTime.description: The start time of the holiday period in ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., "2023-12-19T15:53:00Z")

endTime.description: The endTime of the holiday period in ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., "2023-12-19T16:10"00Z")

holidays.description: Array containing an object list of holidays

channels.description: An array of channel link objects within the location with specific holiday hours set

issues.title: Connection Error
issues.description: Unable to contact your POS system.

eventTime.description: Time stated in UTC is when the sync occurred in Deliverect or when the store changed status, depending on which timestamp is the more accurate measurement

event.description: The values will be either `"storeClosed"` or `"storeOpened"`

reason.description: A string specifying any specific reason (if available) e.g. for example `noDriversAvailable`, `closedByUser`

averageDeliveryTime.description: If available, the average delivery time for a store.

channelLinkId.description: <Glossary>channelLinkId</Glossary> is Deliverect's unique identifier of an individual store in a location

locationId.description: <Glossary>locationId</Glossary> is Deliverect's unique ID of the customer location

posLocationId.description: <Glossary>posLocationId</Glossary> is an identifier of the location known on the POS side, it is stored within the POS config in Deliverect

channel.description: <Glossary>Channel</Glossary> is the global identifier of the channel platform see [Get Integrated Channels](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/channel-integrators)

success.description: Indicates the webhook was received and accepted.
